capabilities: Hide ribbon buttons via right-click or long-press
Toggle hidden buttons back on in a settings tab
Restore all hidden ribbon items at once
Clean up hidden buttons left by removed plugins
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual via release files.
problem: Obsidian's ribbon accumulates buttons from many plugins and offers no built-in way to hide individual ones.
summary: Ribbon customizer that hides left-sidebar ribbon buttons via right-click and manages them from a settings dashboard.
